description: Réfection de la toiture de l'ancienne gare de Châteaubourg (suite à infructuosité) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Châteaubourg. Following an initial consultation consisting of 11 lots for the rehabilitation of the former Châteaubourg station, lot 3 concerning the cover was declared unsuccessful. Following a new consultation, TOURNEUX's tender (SIRET n° 41972182400029) was accepted for an amount of €46,186.60 excluding VAT. Coverage: Commune de Châteaubourg. The portal shows the English title as "Renovation of the roof of the former Châteaubourg railway station (following failure)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Châteaubourg. Its keywords include marches-publics, marches-public. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2025-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
